The '''Slimejack''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the [[Mutant Bug Lair]] during all seasons.

==Map==
The Slimejack can be found in the Mutant Bug Lair.
{{Map|222|139|loc2x=133|loc2y=190}}

==Strategy==
It can be challenging to fish for the Slimejack, as the [[Mutant Fly|Mutant Flies]] inside the Mutant Bug Lair will continuously spawn and attack the player while fishing. To avoid this, fish right at the entrance before any bugs are triggered. It may also be useful to equip a [[Trinkets|trinket]] that will be active during the fishing minigame.

==Tailoring==
Slimejack can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Fishing Hat|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Slimejacks can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 3 days. The initial pond capacity is 1 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing four quests. When the population of the pond reaches 3, the color of the water changes to green. The primary output is green Slimejack [[Roe]], but [[Green Algae]] is possible starting at population 3 and several more valuable items are possible starting at population 9.
